scope: Records 1–14 only; recommendations for existing fields, no catalog edits or production changes.
datePolicy: Precise UTC inspection time retained; lastVerified recommendations use the requested user-facing date in America/New_York (Nov15 while UTC is Nov16). Parent may normalize all catalog dates consistently before applying.

statusDefinitions.VERIFIED: Official facts needed for the proposed wording inspected. Does not certify every individual listing or future form, and preserves explicitly unknown details.
statusDefinitions.PARTIAL: Official program information inspected but missing/mixed-cycle or form-access details remain; recommended text discloses them and does not invent data.
statusDefinitions.UNVERIFIED: No adequate official-source inspection; do not advance lastVerified.
